Enum Class DiversityRating

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DiversityRating>
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.enums.DiversityRating
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<DiversityRating>, Constable
public enum DiversityRating extends Enum<DiversityRating>
Rates the geographic diversity of failover paths for resiliency analysis.

Geographic diversity measures how independent two locations are in terms of shared failure domains (power grids, fiber routes, weather corridors, seismic zones). A backup in the same metro area provides minimal diversity, while a backup on a different continent provides maximum diversity.

Author:
ianjones

  • Enum Constant Details

    • EXCELLENT

      public static final DiversityRating EXCELLENT
      3000 km or more apart — typically cross-region/continental (e.g. Ashburn–Frankfurt). Score 1.0.

    • GOOD

      public static final DiversityRating GOOD
      1500–2999 km apart — good diversity within a continent (e.g. Ashburn–Dallas). Score 0.75.

    • MODERATE

      public static final DiversityRating MODERATE
      500–1499 km apart — some shared infrastructure risk (e.g. Ashburn–Chicago). Score 0.5.

    • POOR

      public static final DiversityRating POOR
      150–499 km apart — limited diversity, likely shared corridors (e.g. Ashburn–New York). Score 0.25.

    • CRITICAL

      public static final DiversityRating CRITICAL
      Under 150 km apart — effectively the same failure domain (same-metro pairings). Score 0.0.

    • UNKNOWN

      public static final DiversityRating UNKNOWN
      The distance between the two metros could not be determined (no facility or Fabric metro coordinates were available for at least one of them). This is an absence of data, not a proximity finding: it is never returned by fromDistance(double) and must be excluded from same-site detection and diversity scoring rather than treated as 0 km (which would falsely read as CRITICAL "same-site"). Its score is a placeholder and must not be averaged into a resiliency score.

    • fromDistance

      public static DiversityRating fromDistance(double distanceKm)
      Rates geographic diversity based on the distance between two metros.

      Only ever returns one of the five distance-based ratings; UNKNOWN is reserved for the caller to assign when the distance itself is unavailable and is never produced here.

      Parameters:
      distanceKm - the distance between primary and backup metros in kilometers
      Returns:
      the diversity rating for the given distance
